inputs.text:
# Week 1
## Day 1
// Light technique work (~40% 1RM)
light: Deadlift / 3x10 / 40% / warmup: none
// **10x10 Deep Water.** Rest **4 min** between sets. Weight stays constant — progression is shorter rest every 2 weeks.
Squat / 10x10 / 54% / 240s
Lunge[1-6] / 3x8 / 65lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Sit Up[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core
Back Extension, Bodyweight[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core

## Day 2
Pull Up[1-6] / 4x8+ / 0lb / warmup: none
Bent Over Row[1-4] / 4x8 / 95lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Clean[1-6] / 3x8 / 65lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Lateral Raise[1-6] / 4x8 / 15lb / progress: dp(2.5lb, 8, 12)
Bicep Curl, Barbell[1-6] / 5x8 / 45lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Sit Up[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core
Back Extension, Bodyweight[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core

## Day 3
// **10x10 Deep Water.** Rest **4 min** between sets. Weight stays constant — progression is shorter rest every 2 weeks.
Push Press, Barbell / 10x10 / 54% / 240s
Lateral Raise[1-6] / 3x8 / 15lb
Bicep Curl, Barbell[1-6] / 5x8 / 45lb
Sit Up[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core
Back Extension, Bodyweight[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core

## Day 4
Bench Press[1-6] / 3x8 / 135lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Bench Press Close Grip[1-6] / 3x8 / 95lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Incline Bench Press[1-6] / 3x8 / 95lb / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 12)
Chest Dip[1-6] / 3x8+ / 0lb / warmup: none
Sit Up[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core
Back Extension, Bodyweight[1-6] / 3x20 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: core
